source.name: Regenerator
source.originalDescription: If this Pokémon doesn't take damage from enemy Pokémon (Wild Pokémon do not count) for 3s, it will recover 3% max HP every 2 seconds. Damage to shields will not deactivate Regenerator. Ho-oh additionally recovers 0.3% max HP every 2 seconds.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Regenerator は シールドを付与する、野生ポケモン限定の処理を持つ。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, shooting out a sweeping flame that deals increased damage and restores HP per enemy Pokémon hit. While firing the sweeping flame Ho-Oh's movement speed is decreased by 30%.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Attack は 移動速度を下げる、HPを回復する、通常攻撃回数により強化攻撃になる。

source.name: Safeguard
source.originalDescription: Create a protective field around the user that reduces the next incoming source of damage by 50%. When this field reduces damage from an attack, the user's movement speed is increased by 40% for 3s.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Safeguard は 移動速度を上げる。

source.name: Tailwind
source.originalDescription: Whip up a whirlwind in designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit. The whirlwind then remains on the field for 5s. Allies moving in the same direction as the whirlwind have their movement speed increased by 30% as long as they are in the field and lasting for 0.5s after stepping out of the field. Opposing Pokémon moving against the whirlwind have their movement speed decreased by 30% lasting for 0.5s after stepping out of the field.
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Tailwind は 移動速度を上げる。

source.name: Rekindling Flame
source.originalDescription: When a nearby ally is knocked out, a feather is left in their place until they respawn at base. When Rekindling Flame is used, Ho-oh spreads their wings and consumes all of the Aeos energy held to revive knocked-out allies where their feathers are for 60% of their maximum HP. Rekindling Flame may only be used if there are feathers nearby. The number of available revivals are based on how much Aeos energy is consumed. One ally may be always revived. Up to two allies are revivable if at least 9 energy is consumed. Up to three allies are revivable if at least 17 Aeos energy is consumed. Up to four allies are revivable if at least 25 Aeos energy is consumed. Buffs: 80% Movement Speed, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Rekindling Flame は シールドを付与する。
